# PenisESP

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** PenisESP

## What it does

Draws a crude 2D shape over other players' positions.

Description basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/modules/render/PenisESP.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
